input_flies.source: olfdb dataset 1 (diagnostics, megamat; 9 flies), E134's copy (data/stage_populations/sources/olfdb/ds1_long.csv); E134's lock's orn / megamat / wild_type flies, sorted, labelled f0 ... f8 (E85's order)
input_flies.slope_rule: E85's: least squares through the origin of the lab's APL16 input on the flies' mean over the 12 shared odors

wirings.seed_index: E136's seed_index: the wiring's position in WIRINGS (pooling and noise), the same for every input fly on that wiring

settings.family: the unrefitted family at each wiring's held megamat point (E136's FAMILY, E134's held targets on megamat, the wiring's own fit's counts on APL16)
settings.A1: E136's A1 at its classed point (measure_strength/fit_A1.json classed_z)
settings.free: 'familyfree' / 'A1free': each model fly at its wiring's held parameters, nothing re-held
settings.familymeas: step 6a: the family on megamat re-held as 'family' (step 1), the input flies' deviations as measured (E85's 'measured')
settings.familyperm: step 6a: the family on megamat re-held as 'family' (step 1), the input flies' reproducible deviations permuted over the glomeruli (E85's 'permuted')

points.order: T wirings first (step 1: T then S; step 2 on T only), fly by fly within a wiring

reading.flies: all the stage's flies (E134); E136's held-out half beside (E136 Flies("held"), HALF_SEED 0)

classes.fair_stand_in: the population's error within the spread as scored of the error of the wirings' mean view at the lab's input; otherwise 'the population reading moves it', nearer or further
classes.a1_apl16: no class: the share of input flies on which A1 is worse than the spread as scored

revisions.what: 'unheld' read with E136's hold tolerance (HOLD_TOL, 0.5 % of each target) in place of exact counts
revisions.why: step 0's first run (09:39) found that E77's hold_rates, which E85's runs and E136's reads use, misses a target by one or two counts on 12 of E85's 72 'repro' runs (at most 0.1 % of ~1900 APL-on and ~4100 APL-off responses), as a bisection on discrete counts can; the entry's 'unheld' means a hold that failed, not a count step. No step 1 or 2 read existed. The first lock is commit 2a58895

revisions.what: step 6a added (the lock's 'step6a', points.step6a and settings 'familymeas' / 'familyperm'): the family on megamat re-held as in step 1 with the nine input flies' deviations as measured (E85's 'measured') and their reproducible deviations permuted over the glomeruli (E85's 'permuted'), 144 reads, T first; per stage and for the megamat stage error the readings "the structure's", "the variance's" and "(e) stands at the upper bound", beside, classing nothing
revisions.why: the planner's word on design item 6 (viki 2026-11-27 20:16; planned by a Fable subagent, claude-fable-5-2, spawned from viki 2026-11-27 19:55): the score's outcomes (c) and (e) (20:07) lack E85's two controls on megamat. No step-6a read existed (the runner's option was not written). Steps 0 to 2, their points, tags, settings, classes and rules are unchanged

e85_groups.B1: 'repro' held, all eight wirings (B1S + B1T): the 72 model flies
e85_groups.B2: 'measured' (s = 1) held, S: the upper bound on the deviations' size
e85_groups.B4: 'permuted' held, S: the deviations without their glomerulus structure

choices: the deviation is E85's 'repro' exactly: r_g pooled over E85's 12 odors (not megamat's 17) times E85's common factor (part_a.json, 1.0), on E85's slope to spike deltas (99.77, the APL16 input on the flies' mean over the 12 shared odors, recomputed from E134's copy), so that a fly's deviation on a shared odor is the same on both panels and its APL16 input is E85's saved 'repro' input; the 17-odor slope (101.1, against the megamat input) and the 17-odor r_g are reported beside, unused
megamat's five odors outside APL16 (aa, va, B-cit, Lin, benz) get the deviation by the same rule; aa and va were not given to f0 and f1 (2023-04-22 flies 2 and 3), which keep the lab's value there

a model fly's error and the population's are read against all the stage's flies (E134's reading: the curve, noise and criterion of all the stage's flies, seed index the wiring's position in E136's WIRINGS, the same for every input fly on that wiring); E136's held-out half beside (E136's Flies('held'): the half's curve and noise, all flies' units), as E136 reads a read

the measure is strength by odor (E136's MEASURES['strength']); the megamat stage error is the root mean square of the four stages' strength errors (E134's writeup 'stage_error_strength'); every view's error beside

the terms of a quantity E[wiring, input fly] (a model fly's error): input-fly term the SD over input flies (ddof 1) of the mean over wirings, wiring term the SD over wirings (ddof 1) of the mean over input flies, remainder the root mean square of the two-way residual (E - row mean - column mean + grand mean) scaled by sqrt(n_w n_f / ((n_w - 1) (n_f - 1))), on a complete wirings x input flies table only

a model fly against the others: its views scored against the mean views of the model flies with another wiring and another input fly (P.score_views on the stage's reference with its mean replaced, so in the recorded flies' one-fly units); a stage's value is the mean over the model flies (min and max beside), the megamat stage error's the mean over model flies of the root mean square over the four stages

'a fair stand-in': |the population's error - the error of the wirings' mean view at the lab's input| <= the spread as scored (E136's classes.json spreads: 'stage' for the megamat stage error, each stage's, 'apl16/apl16/on' and '/off' at the APL16 somata); 'nearer' / 'further' by its sign otherwise; the lab input's value is E134's held megamat runs on the same wirings (step 1: all eight; T only where the population is T's) and E90's part B on APL16

the spread over model flies: the SD (ddof 1) over the model flies of a model fly's error, the quantity whose SD over the eight wirings (ddof 1) E136's spreads are; step 0's APL16 spreads from E85's 72 'repro' held model flies (breadth recomputed per input), the score's from step 2's family APL16 reads (breadth the lab input's) beside them

the classes recomputed with other spreads: every comparison of E136's (measure_strength), E139's and E141's class tables keeps its per-wiring changes; its spread is replaced where a spread over model flies exists, its standard error recomputed by E136's compare (the larger of half the spread and the SD of the changes over sqrt(n)), and the class read by E143's `reclass` ladder (E141's comparisons with A1 and its added classes by E143's `against_a1` and `e141_entry`); with the spreads as scored it must give every scored class (step 0's check); the guard's comparisons (every view) take the all-view spreads over model flies

A1's fall: per model fly (T wiring, input fly) A1's megamat stage error minus the family's on the same wiring and input fly; the mean over the 36; the standard error the larger of the SD over input flies of the per-fly means (over the four wirings) over sqrt(9) and the SD over wirings of the per-wiring means over sqrt(4); it stands if -mean > IMPROVE_SE x se and -mean > CONTROL_FALL; classed against E136's held-out half, where E136's class and the control's 0.040 are read, with all the flies beside

A1 at the APL16 somata: per input fly the mean over the T wirings of A1's strength error minus the family's (step 2's reads, both breadths the lab input's); the share of the nine on which it is above the spread as scored (0.051 with APL on, 0.090 off), and below minus it, beside

the megamat spreads over model flies, for the classes recomputed: the SD over step 1's 72 model flies of each model fly's error against E136's held-out half (the quantity of E136's spreads: 'stage', 'downstream', each stage on strength, the guard's on every view), against all the flies beside; the APL16 spreads from step 0 (E85's 72) and from step 2's family reads (36, on T); the classes recomputed with (a) the megamat spreads, the APL16 ones as scored, (b) both over model flies (E85's APL16), (c) both, step 2's APL16

a fair stand-in at A1's population: against A1's own reads at the lab's input on T (E136's A1 megamat reads); the family's T-only population beside its eight-wiring one; at the APL16 somata against the family's own fits on the same wirings (E90's part B counts, E83's saved fits) and A1's E136 APL16 reads

the beside items: each odor's strength entries by input fly at every megamat stage (the mean view over the wirings of each input fly's model flies minus the flies' mean, in one-fly units), as leads; the views' errors (sharing, breadth) of every population; the somata without aa's entry (E136's `stage_without_odor` rule: aa's term out of the squared error, nothing renormalized); each input fly's megamat input at the ORN stage in its one-fly units (step 0, from the inputs alone); step 2's family APL16 counts beside E85's saved ones on the same wiring and input fly

unheld: a read whose APL-on or APL-off response count misses its target by more than HOLD_TOL (0.5 %, E136's hold tolerance) of the target, or whose threshold or APL factor is at a bound (`is_held`, from the row's n_on, n_off, target_on, target_off, at_bound_thr and at_bound_apl); unheld model flies are left out of every value and counted; a population with more than a ninth unheld has no class; the free reading is not held and has no unheld

the prediction (prediction.json) is a rule written before any read: it is derived from step 0's APL16 numbers and the stage's place (the PN stages see the input before any KC parameter), and says per megamat stage the expected class of each of the three classed questions
holds: no simulation in the lock, step 0 or the score; no olfsysm change
validation2 not read; E145's cells not read
Remy's processed data without the bouton fly 2022-10-21 fly02 and her older megamat flies (E134's lock)

step6a.planned_by: the planner's word on design item 6 (viki 2026-11-27 20:16; a Fable subagent, claude-fable-5-2, spawned from viki 2026-11-27 19:55)
step6a.reads: the family on megamat (E136's FAMILY at each wiring's held megamat point), both response rates re-held as in step 1 (E134's held targets), the breadth the lab input's, the wiring's seed for pooling and noise; the input `input_fly(fly, 'megamat', SETTING_VARIANT[setting])`; every stage saved as in step 1 under run_dirs('6a', setting, wiring, fly) (folder step6a); the row's step '6a' and, where the runner writes one, its 'variant' column the setting's variant (the score checks it with the input's hash)

variants.measured: E85's 'measured' on megamat's 17 odors: each fly's trial mean minus the mean over the flies that have the entry, 0 where unmeasured, no reliability factor (on the 12 shared odors E85's exactly); the upper bound on the deviations' size
variants.permuted: E85's 'permuted' on megamat's 17 odors: the reproducible deviation (`reliabilities` times the above) permuted over each fly's measured glomeruli within each odor by E85's `permute_deviations` (numpy default_rng seeded by the fly's index 0 ... 8, the odors in megamat's order, `orn_flies()['odors']`, so that the draws on the 12 shared odors are not E85's) and re-centred per entry over the flies that have it by E85's `recenter`; the deviations without their glomerulus structure

step6a.order: the T wirings first (P3, P4, M2, M3), then S (real, P1, P2, M1); within a wiring 'familymeas' then 'familyperm', fly by fly f0 ... f8 (144 reads: 36 and 36 on T, then 36 and 36 on S)

readings.population: per megamat stage (strength by odor) and for the megamat stage error, against all the stage's flies (E136's held-out half beside), each of M's and P's populations by step 1's rule: its population's error against the error of the wirings' mean view at the lab's input on the same wirings (E134's held megamat runs), 'a fair stand-in' if the difference is within the spread as scored (the lock's spreads_as_scored: 'stage' and each stage's), else 'moves it nearer' or 'moves it further' by its sign; the reproducible deviations' population (R: step 1's held family reads) on the same wirings beside
readings.wiring_sets: read on T once a variant's 36 T reads are saved and on all eight once its 72 are (both variants for the readings); a population on other wirings is reported with no reading
readings.structure: "the structure's": at a stage where R moves it nearer, P is a fair stand-in
readings.variance: "the variance's": at a stage where R moves it nearer, P moves it nearer too
readings.neither: at a stage where R moves it nearer and P moves it further, neither; where R is a fair stand-in or moves it further, neither is read (M's and P's classes are given)
readings.e_upper_bound: "(e) stands at the upper bound": at a stage where R's model flies vary too little (step 1's reading: a model fly against the others, the mean over the model flies, under 0.75), it stands if under M a model fly against the others (the same mean over M's model flies, on the same wirings) stays under 0.75 (FLIES_LOW), and does not stand otherwise
readings.unheld: step 1's: unheld model flies left out and counted; no reading for a population with more than a ninth of its model flies unheld

step6a.gates: nothing: a description beside the classes; no class as scored, no reading of the stage table and no yardstick changes; which reading is a stage's under 'like for like' stays with Tom and Yang; no fit, search or weighting
